collectible.title: Fishing Book
collectible.subtitle: Includes a page with what you can fish up!
collectible.text:
Welcome aspiring fishers! Here we will give you a friendly guide on how to catch everything your heart desires with that trusty fishing rod!

HOW TO FISH:
If you are playing in a fishing compatible background, the fisher will catch something every time she loses!

FISH RARITY:
Different Pokémon are more likely to show up than others. The more rare the more difficult it is for them to show up!

THE LEGENDARY CATCHES WON'T BITE:
Don't lose hope, fisher! If you keep trying enough times, you'll eventually have the catches guaranteed! It takes a good amount of fishing, but you can do it!

Now go out there, and wield your mighty rod!
collectible.unlock: Finish a game with the fisher.

collectible.title: Fisher Hat
collectible.subtitle: Nice fishing! Have this!
collectible.text: This legendary hat proves you are a real fisher.
